title: Monthly strategy brief and decision lanes — executive snapshot for roadmap alignment
creator: Lena Choi
description: Create a concise monthly executive snapshot that aligns roadmap trade-offs with OKR progress and surfaces decision lanes for leadership. Output: 1) a 1-page strategic brief summarizing portfolio health, risk lanes, and recommended decisions; 2) a 6-slide executive deck for the monthly leadership sync; 3) a decision log with owners and clear next steps. Focus areas: Runtime performance investments vs. Dedicated capacity expansion, Private deployment go-to-market timing, and top 3 cross-team risks that could impact SLAs or enterprise deals.
acceptance_criteria: 1) One-pager in Confluence + PDF that summarizes current quarter roadmap delta, recommended priority shifts (if any), and quantifies near-term impact on OKRs; 2) Executive deck uploaded to Drive and linked in the ticket; 3) Decision log created with owners, due dates, and associated action items; 4) Leadership runway call scheduled and invites sent; 5) Follow-up tracking ticket(s) created for accepted decisions.
